documentation.title: Dry-Run Support
documentation.standard:
Commands that change state (create, update, delete, migrate, sync, import, reset, install, rebuild, ...) or call destructive APIs should support --dry-run, so users can preview the effect. Same-class helpers are followed; declare handling in another class with "@cli-standards dry-run-delegated <reason>".
Requirement: E3 (SHOULD, warning). Error codes: MissingDryRun. Properties: destructiveFunctions (APIs that make a command destructive; '->name' means a $wpdb method), ignoreMethods, ignoreClasses.

code_comparison.code: if ( WP_CLI\Utils\get_flag_value( $assoc_args, 'dry-run', false ) ) { WP_CLI::log( "Would migrate {$count} orders." ); return; }
